title: A held deposit blocks changing the customer and deleting the part sale
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including BOTH Part sales - Create & Edit AND Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit).
  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • A part sale in Estimate, Approved or Complete status, for the customer, with a part (for example "Brake Pads"; Quantity 1; Sell Price for example $290.91).
  • The sale holds a recorded deposit (Deposit Amount for example $50.00; Payment Method for example "Cash").
custom_steps:
1. With the deposit held, try to change the sale's customer (the customer card on the left).
  2. Try the menu ( ... ) at the top of the parts list -> Delete Part Sale.
  3. Remove the deposit (top menu Customers -> the customer -> Deposits tab) and retry both.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • While the sale holds a deposit, its customer cannot be changed and the sale cannot be deleted - both are refused until the deposit is removed; once removed, both are allowed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R13: “While a part sale holds a deposit, its customer cannot be changed and the sale cannot be deleted. Both are refused until the deposit is removed”
